headline: Newark is slowed by low clouds; the other hubs are running normally.

items.text: A ground delay program holds flights into Newark until 11:59 PM ET because of low clouds; delays average 62 minutes, up to 140 minutes.
The other hubs are running normally: every hub reporting so far today is at 85% on time or better, meaning within 30 minutes of schedule.

Ground delay programs for low clouds also hold flights into Las Vegas until 11:59 PM PT, with delays averaging 40 minutes, up to 95 minutes, and into San Diego until 11:59 PM PT, averaging 35 minutes, up to 80 minutes.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Newark, check your flight status before leaving for the airport, and check it as well if you are flying to Las Vegas or San Diego.
